description: Inside the palisade: a strip of oil-black hardstanding and then the rows, rigs nose-in under a sky cut into squares by the fence tops. Nothing is running. There is a hut by the gate with a hatch and a bell push, a laminated card of the release fees screwed to the wall beside it, and a yard dog on a running line who has long ago worked out that the people who come here are not the people worth barking at.
name: Long Stay
